content: Anatumi Isaraele Wambu Dupwa Au Pyuo Rapu Piya
Kamongome namba langyuo,
Wambu peparae Jerusaleme petaminyi dupwa wai pii dake lamaila pupi.

content.text: Nakama wane ene dokopa namba yaki nyii nao suu pyao mona reto kareyami kande lao suu pyao karapunu pilyamo.
Enda mapwae kanda soo yapo nyepala dokopa mona retalamuli pyuo nakamame namba mona reto kareyami.
Nakama yuu muiyane dokonape dee yuu ee nengepe wara pii nange dokonape
nakama namba moko minyuo epeyami.
Isaraele wambu nakama nambana iki yapasi ingyuo
wanyi wanyi pyuo peteyami.
Wambumi nakama randa jiyami dupwa keta
nambane lekeleke koo rao randa nyinya lao maingi.
Namba Kamongo dokome leto,

content: leya.
Isaraele Wambunya Rora Ambasu Dupwana Yulu Koo Dupwa
Nakama Isaraele rara dupwa peparae Kamongona pii dake, selapa.
Kamongome letamo.

content.text: Aki yulu koo lapo embena rora ambasu dupwame namba keta kando nyiyamisi?
Aki mendeme nakama namba yaki nyuo peyamisi?
Nakamame mee bange angi daale dupwa lakando papala
nakama kapa palyuo kara nalyaminyi.
Namba nakama Isipi wambu keta kiiramo nyiyu.
Nyepala yuu muiyane nenge pulya nange
yuu yando dee dokonape
mendali pao pii nange yuu dokona lanyuo peyo.
Peyonopape nakamame namba Kamongo dokoŋo lao pyapi pyuo soo kara nayami.
Nambame nakama yuu amenge pingi nenge jingi lyingipi singi dupwana
rae maiyuo dee nenge lapo dupwana rae maiyuo pirami lapala nambame nakama lanyuo peyo.
Dopa piyunupape nakamame yuu au pyuo narami doko suu pyao
nakamame nambana yuu doko lulya ranyi nembo kokwa siyami.
Purisi dupwame Kamongo anja karase? lao piso see nayami.
Namba rangena purisi dupwame namba soo nyii nayami.
Akali mupwa dupwame nambamoo pipya mona kana pokoyami.
Poropeta dupwame mee bange kingimi wasisi Bealo lenge dokona lao poropeta pii leyami
dee mee bange angi mende ingya nayamo dupwana kingi lao peyami.

content: Kamongona Kote Pii Ingyuo Banya Wambu Dupwa Pipya YandaPimwaiyuo Leya

content.text: Dokona lao namba Kamongo dokome nambana wambu dupwa pipya yanda pimwaiyuo nambana kote pii doko lao retakamiru.
Nakamana para pyaraminyi dupwa keta nambame nakama koo piyami laro.
Neta yalyingi dorena yuu kuki Saiporasa dokona pupi.
Papala yuu Keta dokona neta pyakaenge dorena ingyuo mendali pena lape.
Larene dokopa yulu dapale mende wamba pii nangende piyamo kanda nangende pira doko emba kandare.
Wambu rara yuu liti wakale dupwame nakamana anatu dupwa anatu angi daa ingiyamopape
yaki nyepala kaeya nange.
Dopa piyamopape nambana wambu dupwa nambame nakama rape rape lao minyingi doko kaepala
mee bange anatu dupwame nakama kando mende pii nara doko nambana panda dokona alowa pyuo dupwana kingi lao karaminyi.
Dokona nambame yake doko yuusili minyili lao paka pinyi pyambuo
yamarangunya lao romo romo andake pinya lao leto.
Dokona lao nambana wambu dupwame yulu koo lama ingyuo piyami.
Nakamame namba ipwa kamuo nenge guu lao epenge doko mata jiyami.
Jepala nakamame ipwa pete sinya lao yuwale kyasiyami.
Kyasiyaminyipape yuu kipwa kipwa dupwa yando nao poro lao rali pipala ipwa naku pao karo angi see naya.

content: Isaraele Wambu Dupwame Anatu Mata Maiyuo Randa Nyiyami

content.text: Isaraele wambu dupwa nakama kendemande daa.
Nakama kendemande ingyuo manjo nyii nayami.
Nakamana nyisu pentenge dupwame akipamo koto pyao karamisi?
Nakamame Isaraele dupwa kando menda laene ingyuo nenge pyakilyapala pii letaminyi.
Nakamame Isaraele wambunya yuu dupwa pyao apa yuu retelyaminyi.
Dee nakamana yuu taone dupwa mee ukiaki minyasi sipyamo kame soo kaeyo otelyaminyi.
Waa, yuu Memipisi akalipi dee yuu Tapanese akali dupwamepe
Isaraele wambunya kyawa kuli doko pyao poro lakamilyaminyi.
Nambame nakama Isaraele wambunya kata wapwakao pupunu dokopa
nakamame namba nakamana Kamongo Anatu doko kame soo yaki nyiyami dokome
randa dake nakama range keta nyilyaminyi.
Nakamame Isipi pao ipwa Naele dokona ipwa napala
aki bange mende nyerama lao suu pilyamisi?
Nakama yuu Asiria pao ipwa Yuporisa dokona ipwa napala
aki bange mende nyerama lao suu pilyamisi?
Nakama rangena koo dokome nakama randa jera.
Dee nakamame namba mata jiyami dokome koo ingyuo karaminyi lao lasaka pirasa pira.
Dopa piramo dokopa nakamana Kamongo Anatu namba doko yaki nyuo kaeyamo doko
yulu ama koo wakasa lao soo nyerami.
Namba Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa Ama Porai dokome lapunu pilyamo.

content: Isaraele Wambu Dupwame Kamba Lao Kamongo Lakanda Narama, Leyami

content.text: Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa dokome lao,
Isaraele wambu dupwa nakamame yuu wamba nambana porainya renge doko kilya kandeyami.
Nakamame namba kamba lao warombo soo lakanda nayami.
Lapala yuu kyau ketae dupwanape
dee isa renge isarena dupwana
anatu angi daa dupwame namwana ee nengepe menape ree palupi dupwa kapa andanyi pyambungi lao lakandeyami.
Nambame nakama isa girapo yapasi
waingi angi doko dopale wara piyu.
Dopa piyunupape nakama epapu apiyakale karamano lao kandalapa.
Nakama isa girapo momo nao kupwa nenge koo dopale ingilyaminyi.
Nakama sopo porai dokome wate piminyipape
nakamana koo doko kyaya roo dopale ingyuo mee piro karapyamo kandelyo.
Apa pyuo namwa range koo pali nangeŋe.
Namwa mee bange anatu kingi Bealo doko lakanda nangeŋe laramisi?
Nakama yuu anda lama lama dokona
apa pyuo koo piyami doko kandalapa.
Nakama mena kamele inya pundapala kalyuwa koto ralo papyuo karenge dopale ingilyaminyi.
Yuu muiyane dokona papyuo karenge mena kamele pundapala
kalyuwa nyelana suu pingi dokopa mendeme baa minyaro see nange ingilyamo.
Dee mena kamele kalyuwa mendeme mena kamele inya doko nyelana suu pingi dokome koto paa nange.
Kamele inya dokome wambo pao rapa rapa piru karenge. Nakama dopale ingilyaminyi.
Isaraele dupwa mee anatu angi daa dupwa anja lao pete pete papiramisa
nakama kimbu kape rando
dee nakamana pendoko nyuo pisaraŋa dopa pyuo papi nalapape.
Pii naraminyipape nakamame lao, Daaŋa namwa kapu kyuo epa narama.
Namwa mee bange anatu wakale dupwa mona retapala dupwa
moko minyuo panya pilyamano letaminyi.

content: Isaraele Dupwa Koo Keta Palyuo Randa Maira Ingiya

Kamongo dokome lao, Waa nyingi akali doko minyaro nyepala kando lenge dokopa baa pakao elyange. Doko suu pyao nakama Isaraele wambu peparae elyame kumarami. Nakamana kiŋipi akali mupwa dupwape purisi dupwape poropeta dupwape peparae elyame kumarami.

Nakamame lao, Isa doko namwana rakane dee kana doko namwana endangi letaminyi. Dokona nakama peparae elya nyerami. Dokona nakamame namba mata jepala namba karo dokona kapu kyuo epa naminyidokona dake pipalako kaeyaro. Dopa piminyipape nakama randa nyepala dokopa nambame nakama kyawa lete nyele ipu lao piso singi.

Nakama rangena anatu kingimi wasiyami dupwa anja karamisi? Nakama koo keta palipala rangena anatu dupwame nyisingi ramo doko nyisinya larami. Juta wambu dupwa nakamana yuu taone malu karenge dokoko suu pyao nakamana mee bange malu anatuŋu lao karaminyi.
Nakama mumu lao pii letaminyi doko akisi? Akipamo nakamame nambamoo pipya yanda pimwaiyuo letamisi?

Nambame nakama mana langyuo pyalana pipunupape dokome nakama nyiso rola nalyamo. Nambame nakama kata rolae lasaka pyuo dopa pii dapa lao langi laa nalyaminyi. Mena laene gasimwa pokapala nenge nenge manjo pii lenge dopale ingyuo nakamame nakamana poropeta dupwa pyao kumuyami.

Isaraele wambu dupwa nambame apa letene lao selapape. Nambame nakama kando yuu muiyane dopale ingyuo dee yuu iminjingipi randa sipurengepe yuu dopale ingyuo karose? Namba dopa pii nange dokona akipamo nakama namba karo dokona kapu kyuo epa naramaŋa lao yulu nakama rae mailyamanuli pyuo pinya letamisi?

Enda mapwae dokome baa kalya pyuo akali nyela penge dokona banya mamakupi dee kalya bangepe dupwa kame soo yaki nyingisi? Doko daa. Dopa pii nange doko kaepala nambana wambu dupwame yuu gii malu namba kame silyaminyi doko yaka lapenge daa.

Isaraele wambu dupwa nakama pamuku endame akali anja karaminyi lao pyarako soo nyingi dopale ingyuo palyaminyi. Nakamame kamame koo wakasa pilyaminyi dokona pamuku enda wakale dupwa nakamana yulu koo pilyaminyi doko kando mana nyilyaminyi.
Akali kuki mee kamenge karenge dupwa waa nyakaminyipili lao pyaminyisa ranjama dupwame nakamana komau dupwa para para pilyamo. Dopa pyuo karapalape

nakamame lao, Namwa koo pii nange. Kamongo dokome namwa kando imbwa nara, lao letaminyi. Dopa laraminyipape nakama koo pipala koo pii nalyamano letaminyi dokona namba Kamongo dokome nakama randa jero.

Pamuku enda kepo pyuo papingi doko suu pyao nakamana suu pingi alowa pilya pyana pyuo kata wakale wakale pelyaminyi. Dokona Asiria wambu dupwame nakama nyisa nayami. Dopaleko ingyuo Isipi wambu dupwame nakama nyisa naramiko ingyaramopa nakama mona randarami.

Namba Kamongo dakeme wambu nakama mona mailyaminyi dupwa nambame mata mailyuŋu dokona nakama keta bange mendepe jeraminyi nyuo paa narami. Dokona nakama ayemba yuwa lapala elyame kumuo Isipi yaki nyuo eparami.

3:1—6:15 Juta wambumi mee bange kingimi wasisi anatuŋu lao lakando kareyaminyi dokona Anatumi kote lara, Jeremaya leya. Yuu dokona wambu dupwame wambu yango randa maiyuo yulu rolae pii nao kopetame pyuo kareyaminyi dokome randa epara lao poropeta Jeremaya repe repe pyuo lamaiya.
